tagline: A purpose-driven global investment organization focused on active ownership strategies
hero_kpi_rationale: Primary driver of EQT's recurring and predictable business model, directly linked to management fee revenues. This is the best indicator of structural trajectory in asset management.

kpis.name: Fee-generating assets under management
kpis.explanation: Amount of assets under management that generate fees for EQT.
kpis.description: Fee-generating AUM is the primary driver of EQT's recurring revenues, tied to management fees collected.

kpis.name: Total assets under management
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets managed by EQT for its funds and investment vehicles.
kpis.description: Total AUM includes all assets, including non-fee-generating ones, and reflects the overall size of the group.
kpis.signal: Exceeds EUR 245 billion, supported by performance and fundraising

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees at EQT worldwide.
kpis.description: EQT maintains a substantial workforce to support its active ownership model at a global scale.

kpis.name: AUM growth
kpis.explanation: Annual growth rate of total assets under management.
kpis.description: AUM growth is driven by fundraising, investment performance, and IPOs.
kpis.signal: High growth rate in a competitive sector

kpis.name: Number of countries with offices
kpis.explanation: Number of countries where EQT operates offices.
kpis.description: EQT has a strong international footprint, essential for its active ownership approach.
kpis.signal: Consolidated global presence across Europe, Asia, and the Americas

kpis.name: Investment horizon (years)
kpis.explanation: Average holding period of investments by EQT funds.
kpis.description: EQT follows a long-term ownership philosophy, typical of European funds such as those from the Wallenberg family.
kpis.signal: Model based on long-term value creation

ai_positioning.summary: EQT does not appear as a direct player in generative AI or AI semiconductors. Its positioning is cautious, with potential AI integration in analysis processes via internal or partner tools, without marked strategic announcement.
evidence: No mention of AI in press release or business description
Focus on active ownership and asset management, not technology or tech innovation
No references to recent investments in AI startups or cloud
